public_rationale: The testing supports a real reliability concern, while the benchmark shows substantial capability in a different browser agent. Neither establishes the full three-part claim. Treating occasional success as sufficient disproof would impose an unusually literal reading; treating frequent intervention in one product as proof about all agents would overgeneralize.
limitations: One independent evaluation is small and informal.
The vendor benchmark is not an Operator test.
The verdict depends partly on what counts as working reliably.
